info.title: e-Boekhouden.nl Universal API
info.description: Dutch bookkeeping and accounting platform for invoices, relations, ledgers, and financial administration.

post.description: Creates a new cost center in e-Boekhouden.nl.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

description.description: The description of the cost center. Error codes COST_003 Cost center description is required. COST_004 Cost center description is too long. COST_005 Cost center with this name already exists on this level of the tree. COST_011 Cost center fullPath is too long. COST_012 Cost center description has invalid characters.

parentId.description: The parent ID of the cost center. Error codes COST_005 Cost center with this name already exists on this level of the tree. COST_006 Cost center parent id cannot be changed. COST_007 Cost center parent is not active. COST_008 Cost center parent not found.

active.description: Whether the cost center is active. Error codes COST_007 Cost center parent is not active.

post.description: Creates a new invoice in e-Boekhouden.nl.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

invoiceNumber.description: Invoice number. Must end with a number. If empty, we will create a new number. Error codes FACT_006 Invoice number is missing. FACT_007 Invoice number is too long. FACT_008 Invoice number is invalid. FACT_009 Invoice number does not end with a digit. FACT_101 Invoice number is in use.

relationId.description: The ID of a relation. Error codes FACT_001 Relation ID is missing. FACT_002 Relation not found. FACT_003 Relation is inactive. FACT_EMAIL_001 Relation email is missing. FACT_EMAIL_002 Relation email is invalid. FACT_EMAIL_003 Relation email for invoices is invalid. FACT_EMAIL_004 Relation email for reminders is invalid. FACT_EMAIL_007 Relation email is missing.

date.description: Invoice date. Error codes FACT_011 Invoice date is missing. FACT_012 Invoice date invalid. FACT_013 Invoice date out of range.

termOfPayment.description: Error codes FACT_015 Term of payment is missing. FACT_016 Term of payment out of range.

inExVat.description: Indicates if the amount on the invoice is including (`IN`) or excluding (`EX`) VAT. The corresponding value will be calculated based on the VAT code. If left empty the 'EX' option will be used Error codes FACT_010 Invoice VAT must be IN or EX.

templateId.description: Error codes FACT_018 Invoice template not found.

emailTemplateId.description: The ID of an email template. Error codes FACT_020 Email template not found.

reference.description: Reference of the invoice. Error codes FACT_014 Payment reference is too long.

text.description: Text of the invoice. Error codes FACT_017 Invoice text is too long.

print.description: Determines whether the invoice should be prepared for printing.

email.fromEmail.description: Email address of the sender. Error codes FACT_EMAIL_006 Sender email is invalid.

email.subject.description: Email subject. Error codes FACT_EMAIL_013 Subject is missing.

email.body.description: Email body. Supports HTML. Error codes FACT_EMAIL_011 Email body is too long FACT_EMAIL_014 Body is missing.

email.invoiceUbl.description: Obsolete; please use `attachUbl` instead. This field will be removed in the future.

directDebit.iban.description: Error codes FACT_INCASSO_008 IBAN is missing. FACT_INCASSO_009 IBAN is too long. FACT_INCASSO_010 IBAN is invalid.

directDebit.mandateType.description: `O` or `E` (one-time debit), `R` or `D` (recurrent debit) Error codes FACT_INCASSO_001 Mandate type is missing. FACT_INCASSO_002 Mandate type is invalid.

directDebit.mandateId.description: Error codes FACT_INCASSO_003 Mandate ID is missing. FACT_INCASSO_004 Mandate ID is too long.

directDebit.mandateSignedDate.description: Error codes FACT_INCASSO_005 Mandate signed date is missing. FACT_INCASSO_006 Mandate signed date is invalid. FACT_INCASSO_007 Mandate signed date out of range.

directDebit.name.description: In the name of. Error codes FACT_INCASSO_011 Name is too long.

directDebit.city.description: Error codes FACT_INCASSO_012 City is too long.

directDebit.descriptionLine1.description: Error codes FACT_INCASSO_013 Description line 1 is too long.

directDebit.descriptionLine2.description: Error codes FACT_INCASSO_014 Description line 2 is too long.

directDebit.descriptionLine3.description: Error codes FACT_INCASSO_015 Description line 3 is too long.

mutation.description.description: Description of the mutation. Error codes FACT_VERWERK_002 Description is too long.

mutation.checkPaymentReference.description: If true, the provided `paymentReference` will be validated for uniqueness.

mutation.paymentReference.description: A reference that uniquely identifies the mutation. Error codes FACT_VERWERK_003 Payment reference is too long. FACT_VERWERK_004 Payment reference already exists. MUTA_008 Payment reference already exists.

mutation.ledgerId.description: Ledger of the invoice entry. Error codes MUT_007 Unknown ledger for mutation.

items[].quantity.description: The item quantity, with up to 4 decimal places.

items[].amount.description: The item quantity. To keep your code ready for future API versions it is recommended to use `quantity` instead.

items[].unitId.description: The ID of an existing unit. Error codes FACT_ITEM_010 Unit not found.

items[].code.description: Error codes FACT_ITEM_003 Code invoice item is too long.

items[].productId.description: The ID of an existing product. If given, `Code` is ignored. Error codes FACT_ITEM_011 Product not found.

items[].description.description: Error codes FACT_ITEM_001 Description invoice item is missing. FACT_ITEM_002 Description invoice item is too long.

items[].pricePerUnit.description: Error codes FACT_ITEM_004 Price per unit excl. VAT is missing. FACT_ITEM_008 Total price is too high. FACT_ITEM_009 Total price is too low.

items[].vatCode.description: A list of VAT codes is displayed below. | Value | Description | |---|---| | HOOG_VERK_21 | For selling with 21% VAT. | | LAAG_VERK_9 | For selling with 9% VAT. | | VERL_VERK | For selling with reverse-charging 21% VAT. | | VERL_VERK_L9 | For selling with reverse-charging 9% VAT. | | AFW | VAT percentage is unspecified. Price values will be used | | BU_EU_VERK | Deliveries outside the EU, 0% VAT. | | BI_EU_VERK | Goods inside the EU, 0% VAT. | | BI_EU_VERK_D | Services inside the EU, 0% VAT. | | AFST_VERK | Distance sales inside the EU, 0% VAT. | | LAAG_INK_9 | For buying with 9% VAT. | | HOOG_INK_21 | For buying with 21% VAT. | | VERL_INK | For buying with reverse-charging VAT. | | AFW_VERK | For selling with unspecified VAT percentage. Price values will be used. | | BU_EU_INK | For buying goods/services from outside the EU, 0% VAT. | | BI_EU_INK | For buying goods/services from inside the EU, 0% VAT. | | GEEN | No VAT. |

items[].vatAmount.description: The VAT amount of the invoice item. Only use in combination with vatCode: 'AFW_VERK'. Only applicable for NL. Error codes FACT_ITEM_015 VAT amount must be used with VAT code: 'AFW_VERK'

items[].ledgerId.description: The ID of an existing ledger account Error codes FACT_ITEM_007 Ledger ID is missing FACT_ITEM_012 Ledger account not found.

items[].discountAmount.description: A fixed discount on the `pricePerUnit`. This field can not be combined with `discountPercentage`.

items[].discountPercentage.description: A percentage discount on the `pricePerUnit`. This field can not be combined with `discountAmount`.

post.description: Creates a new mutation in e-Boekhouden.nl.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

type.description: A list of mutation types is displayed below. | Value | Description | |---|---| | 1 | Invoice received | | 2 | Invoice sent | | 3 | Invoice payment received | | 4 | Invoice payment sent | | 5 | Money received | | 6 | Money sent | | 7 | General journal entry |

date.description: The date of the mutation. Error codes MUT_003 Date is missing.

ledgerId.description: The ledger ID of the mutation. Error codes MUTA_001 Ledger id is missing. MUT_007 Unknown ledger for mutation.

invoiceNumber.description: The invoice number of the mutation. Error codes MUT_018 Invoice number is too long. MUT_019 Invoice number already exists. MUT_002 Invoice number is missing.

termOfPayment.description: The term of payment from `date`, in days. Error codes MUT_016 Term of payment is prohibited.

checkPaymentReference.description: If true, the provided `paymentReference` will be validated for uniqueness.

paymentReference.description: The payment reference of the mutation.

inExVat.description: Indicates if the amount on mutation rows is including (`IN`) or excluding (`EX`) VAT. The corresponding value will be calculated based on the VAT code. Error codes MUT_017 In/Ex VAT must be 'IN' or 'EX'. MUTA_005 In/Ex VAT is missing.

relationId.description: The relation id of the mutation. Error codes MUT_012 Relation is missing. MUT_013 Relation not found.

rows[].ledgerId.description: The ledger ID of the row. Required in combination with `type`: 1, 2, 5, 6, 7. For `type` 1, 2, 5, 6 ledger cannot be in the category: `FIN`, `CRED`, `DEB`. For `type` 7 ledger can be any. Error codes MUTA_004 Ledger ID for row is missing. MUT_007 Unknown ledger for mutation. MUT_104 Unknown ledger for row. MUT_106 Invalid ledger category for row.

rows[].vatCode.description: A list of VAT codes is displayed below. | Value | Description | |---|---| | HOOG_VERK_21 | For selling with 21% VAT. | | LAAG_VERK_9 | For selling with 9% VAT. | | VERL_VERK | For selling with reverse-charging 21% VAT. | | VERL_VERK_L9 | For selling with reverse-charging 9% VAT. | | AFW | VAT percentage is unspecified. Price values will be used | | BU_EU_VERK | Deliveries outside the EU, 0% VAT. | | BI_EU_VERK | Goods inside the EU, 0% VAT. | | BI_EU_VERK_D | Services inside the EU, 0% VAT. | | AFST_VERK | Distance sales inside the EU, 0% VAT. | | LAAG_INK_9 | For buying with 9% VAT. | | HOOG_INK_21 | For buying with 21% VAT. | | VERL_INK | For buying with reverse-charging VAT. | | AFW_VERK | For selling with unspecified VAT percentage. Price values will be used. | | BU_EU_INK | For buying goods/services from outside the EU, 0% VAT. | | BI_EU_INK | For buying goods/services from inside the EU, 0% VAT. | | GEEN | No VAT. |

rows[].vatAmount.description: The VAT amount of the row. Only use in combination with vatCode: 'AFW_VERK' or 'AFW'. Only applicable for NL.

rows[].costCenterId.description: The cost center id of the row.

rows[].amount.description: The amount of the row. This value includes or excludes VAT depending on the `inExVat` value of the mutation.

rows[].invoiceNumber.description: The invoice number of the row. Required for type 'Invoice payment received' and 'Invoice payment sent'. Error codes MUT_115 Invoice not found. MUT_120 Invoice number is missing.

rows[].relationId.description: The relation id of the row. Error codes MUT_112 Relation is missing. MUT_113 Relation not found.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

code.description: The code of the product. Error codes ART_004 Product Code is missing. ART_007 Product Code is too long.

description.description: The description of the product. Error codes ART_005 Product Description is missing.

unitId.description: The unit ID of the product. Error codes ART_011 Product Unit could not be found.

groupId.description: The group ID of the product. Error codes ART_012 Product Group could not be found.

purchasePriceExcl.description: The purchase price (excluding VAT) of the product. Error codes ART_027 The value of PurchasePriceExcl exceeds the maximum value of 999999999999.00. ART_032 The value of PurchasePriceExcl is below the minimum value of -999999999999.00.

priceExcl.description: The price (excluding VAT) of the product. This field can not be combined with `priceIncl`. Error codes ART_018 Either priceExcl or priceIncl is required. ART_019 Both priceExcl and priceIncl are required with current VAT code. ART_024 The value of PriceExcl exceeds the maximum value of 999999999999.00. ART_026 The value of PriceIncl after applying VAT exceeds the maximum value of 999999999999.00. ART_029 The value of PriceExcl is below the minimum value of -999999999999.00. ART_031 The value of PriceIncl after applying VAT is below the minimum value of -999999999999.00.

priceIncl.description: The price (including VAT) of the product. This field can not be combined with `priceExcl`. Error codes ART_016 priceIncl cannot have a value when priceExcl is passed. ART_018 Either priceExcl or priceIncl is required. ART_019 Both priceExcl and priceIncl are required with current VAT code. ART_025 The value of PriceIncl exceeds the maximum value of 999999999999.00. ART_030 The value of PriceIncl is below the minimum value of -999999999999.00.

vat.description: The VAT code of the product. Only supports VAT codes of type 'Sale'. Error codes ART_013 Product VAT code could not be found. ART_017 Product VAT code is required.

ledgerId.description: The ledger ID of the product. Error codes ART_006 Product Ledger ID is missing. ART_009 Product Ledger could not be found. ART_028 Ledger category must be 'BAL' or 'VW'.

costCenterId.description: The cost center ID of the product. Error codes ART_010 Product Cost center is inactive. ART_015 Product cost center could not be found.

inStockManagement.description: Whether the product will be Included in automatic inventory management.
